title: Startup and host integration
invariant: Follow the host boundary: workspace identity scopes the mounted runtime; native panel navigation and DOM stay inside its host. Native panel sizing must fill the viewport remainder in HA’s auto-height wrapper while preserving sidebar flow and safe-area padding.

title: Project schema and persistence
invariant: Trace draft, published state and revision checks before changing persistence; preserve portable IDs and migrations. Personal GLBs are immutable SHA assets outside snapshots; references and record publication share a transaction. Unsupported fields and newer schema versions stay blocked and explain the HACS update, restart and reload recovery path. Weather source preferences are private and origin-scoped; their revision-checked save updates only that field in draft and published profiles.

title: Editor coordination
invariant: Keep mode coordination separate from domain edits, history, persistence and presentation; Apply is the publication boundary. Shared draft diagnostics remain available in every editor mode; Locate selects and focuses the affected object on its floor, including wall attachments.

title: Construct and floor topology
invariant: Start at topology and validation for architectural changes: walls own openings; junctions and derived collision must agree. Optional door/window finish colors follow opening history and persistence without changing geometry. North orientation previews around the plan; only confirmation commits the shared building angle. Boundary (H) reuses hedge drawing, selection and persisted IDs. Wall edge color uses Auto or a persisted custom CSS color; Auto inherits matching authored side colors, then authored exterior color, otherwise the general interior wall finish. Face color controls follow wall direction and adjacent-room labels, preserve the opposite side, reset to the home palette, and highlight the edited face without persisting UI state. Wall niches remain wall-owned, preserve their backing through wall thickness edits and solid walk collision, and share placement, selection and resize gestures with doors and windows; Decorations groups Niche, Boundary and Pool.

title: Arrange and placement
invariant: Resolve catalog definitions and supported placement before changing item records; preserve floor and item identity through history. Optional fabric colors follow item history and persistence; model defaultColor enables the picker. 3D elevation dragging preserves support and horizontal placement, commits one history step on release, and restores the initial placement on cancellation. Proportional resize dragging preserves placement, respects model resize policies, and shares the single-transaction commit/cancel behavior.

title: Connect and binding profiles
invariant: Keep local slot declarations separate from browser household mappings; matching and rescan remain read-only.

title: Personal GLB models and asset transfer
invariant: Distribute the standalone authoring skill from the public cabane-app/agent-skills repository. Keep personal import and illustrated AI-generation guidance inside Arrange's My models section. Manage models directly in its single preview grid, with hover, keyboard and touch access. Resolve personal definitions per project; validate self-contained GLBs and resource budgets before storage. Preserve materials, share and dispose resources, and publish verified assets before documents. Keep private bindings and authenticated transfers isolated by HA origin; interrupted transfers preserve the prior revision.

title: Home Assistant runtime and controls
invariant: Resolve and authorize supported controls at runtime; credentials and household IDs stay outside generated home source. Storage transfers remain bound to their originating authenticated session. Demo devices stay in memory, and simulated lights start on when the demo opens in night lighting while remaining manually controllable. Demo fans start at 50% speed and valves start open; normal controls update their in-memory state and existing catalog animations respect reduced motion.

title: Dashboard, navigation and cameras
invariant: Room selection glides to a consistent angle fitted beside controls; manual navigation interrupts and retains active pointer listeners across dashboard re-renders, reduced motion settles immediately, and overview restores the default floor framing. The combined floor summary expands floor pills that update the active floor and room list; mobile keeps the floor pill and hides room pills. Keep floor switching and walk state coherent; missing runtime data must leave a usable scene. Room and device modules use content-sized cards and wrapping titles, with compact controls that preserve usable action targets. Sheet navigation puts actions on the left and Close on the right, retaining a left Back action only for nested device details; it overlays an edge-to-edge sticky parallax hero with reserved title clearance; mobile room sheets use a border and shadow with 54dvh height, coordinated with scene framing. Overlay preferences persist locally and filter only overview summaries. Area temperature/humidity readings take precedence over usable mapped room sensor fallbacks. RoomControlSheet and useRoomModuleOrder own browser-local per-home/room module order; RoomModuleReorder provides pointer, touch, and keyboard reordering without HA commands. Weather shares the Build/View tray and SceneActionButton rendering, uses matching sculpted icons and six preview choices (Live, Sunny, Cloudy, Rain, Thunderstorm, Snowy), defaults to Sunny with Live disabled when no HA weather entity exists, and applies only a visit-local scene override; it never changes HA state or the saved weather source.

title: Scene geometry and rendering
invariant: Architecture owns derived geometry and collision; the linked rendering contract defines finish, lighting, fade, shadow, and contour invariants. Authored geometry and hosted assets follow the visual-asset contract; personal GLBs use their dedicated import owner. Outline smoothing owns its derived geometry and preserves authored source normals.

title: Catalog and model extensions
invariant: Inspect stable registries first and consume public catalog subpaths. The linked catalog contract owns model placement, variants, activity, animation, and saved-project compatibility; home extensions own bespoke geometry. Mandatory surface verification covers all furnishing and device variants, including all four device connection states; flat artwork uses the engine LayeredSurface contract. Reusable additions exclude tiny standalone props and fitted apartment parts; square storage variants share one frame, and wall-mounted awnings retain wall support. Ordinary preset coverage uses shared catalog/surface checks and UI review.

title: Optional walk tools
invariant: Register optional tools in the web host; injected navigation, activation and storage keep HA access inside the engine. Prepare and retain shot shader programs on equip to avoid trigger-time compilation. The gun owns its first-use tutorial and browser-local dismissal. Engine targeting toggles one available light, fan, climate, media-player, switch or valve binding, preserving explicit slot scope and rejecting ambiguous targets.

title: Bundled home and agent generation
invariant: Author one accepted layout or room stage at a time in home/; browser edits do not rewrite the bundled seed. Follow the generation skill review gates.

title: Verification and delivery
invariant: The delivery contract defines local verification, execution permissions, pre-push enforcement, and HA release provenance. Route iteration checks through verify:help; shared product delivery requires the full gate. Native panel verification permits only the documented pinned weather texture outside the host origin.

title: Shortcuts and private HA actions
invariant: Keep shortcut order and kinds portable; scene/script entity IDs belong to origin-scoped draft/published binding profiles. Save publishes both atomically. Activation uses guarded one-shot commands, never toggles.

title: Engine UI styles
invariant: The public styles.css entry point owns explicit cascade order; global foundations live in styles/ and feature styles sit beside their React owners. Dashboard layout files and room-navigation.css coordinate cross-component responsive placement. Read room-navigation.css with room-control-sheet styles for room-focus changes. Extraction preserves selectors, declarations, media/container conditions, reduced-motion behavior and source order. React mounting order must not determine shared CSS precedence.
